caseName: United States v. Baltimore & Annapolis Railroad
caseNameFull: United States v. Baltimore & Annapolis Railroad Co.
attorneys: Assistant Attorney General Shea, with whom Solicitor General Jackson and Messrs. Warner W. Gardner, Paul A. Sweeney, and Enoch E. Ellison were on the brief, for the United States. Mr. Edgar Allan Poe was on a brief for the Baltimore & Annapolis Railroad Co., and Mr. J. Purdon Wright was on a brief for O. E. Weller et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question. Hendrick v. Maryland, 235 U. S. 610, 622-623; Kane v. New Jersey, 242 U. S. 160, 167; Hodge Co. v. Cincinnati, 284 U. S. 335, 337; South Carolina State Highway Dept. v. Barnwell Bros., 303 U. S. 177, 189.
